_meta.description: D6 fixtures for strands-typescript / interrupt-headless. The tool call these fixtures emit reaches a backend tool that pauses on Strands' native interrupt, so the bridge translates it into an AG-UI interrupt outcome. The tool takes only topic and attendee: candidate slots are generated by the frontend. Note: interrupt-headless drives the same two prompts as gen-ui-interrupt against the same backend agent, and aimock loads this directory alphabetically with first-match-wins, so in practice the gen-ui-interrupt legs serve both demos. These legs are kept in step with that file so either load order behaves identically.

fixtures._comment: sales-call pill, first leg: the model calls schedule_meeting. The backend tool pauses itself via tool_context.interrupt(...), which the bridge finishes as RUN_FINISHED outcome interrupt, so the picker mounts.
